claims: The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic is an inaugural 5-on-5 tournament.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic takes place at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles on March 21, 2026.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic is hosted by Kevin Hart.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic airs live on FOX Sports, FOX One, and Tubi at 4 PM ET.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic features a 50×25-yard Olympic-style format.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic features three teams competing in a round-robin format.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic is played with 20-minute halves.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic is played on a 50-yard field.
The 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic features the U.S. Men's National Flag Football Team.
In the 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic, Team Founders is led by Tom Brady and Jalen Hurts.
In the 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic, Team Wildcats is led by Joe Burrow and Jayden Daniels.
In the 2026 Fanatics Flag Football Classic, Team USA is the reigning IFAF World Champion U.S. Men's National Flag Football Team.
